task_completion.description: Create a new administrator account with username 'sec_admin' and email 'security@example.com'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the WordPress 'Users' list showing 'sec_admin' with the 'Administrator' role and the correct email address.

task_completion.description: Delete the original 'admin' user and reassign content to 'sec_admin'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the deletion confirmation page where 'Attribute all content to: sec_admin' is selected, or the 'Users' list showing 'admin' is no longer present.

task_completion.description: Disable the built-in theme and plugin file editor via wp-config.php.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of a terminal or text editor showing 'define( 'DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true );' added to /var/www/html/wordpress/wp-config.php, or the 'Theme File Editor' menu item missing from the WordPress Appearance sidebar.

task_completion.description: Install and activate the 'UpdraftPlus WordPress Backup Plugin'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the 'Plugins' page showing 'UpdraftPlus - Backup/Restore' as 'Active'.

task_completion.description: Set both file and database backup schedules to 'Weekly'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of UpdraftPlus 'Settings' tab showing 'Files backup schedule' and 'Database backup schedule' both set to 'Weekly'.

task_completion.description: Set the backup retention limit to '4'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of UpdraftPlus 'Settings' tab showing the retention setting (number of scheduled backups to keep) set to '4' for both files and database.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress dashboard GUI for user management and plugin configuration.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the WordPress admin panel menus and forms rather than only using WP-CLI or SQL commands.

integrity.description: The agent searched for and installed the plugin from the official repository or uploaded the genuine file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Add Plugins' search results for 'UpdraftPlus' and the subsequent installation process.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo 'Success' or create dummy files to mimic completion.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The new administrator must be 'sec_admin' with email 'security@example.com'. The original 'admin' user must be deleted. The file /var/www/html/wordpress/wp-config.php must contain 'define( 'DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true );'. UpdraftPlus must be configured for 'Weekly' backups with a retention count of '4'.
